test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-2) Official Paper (Held On: 16 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: What is the full form of MGNREGA, an Act that provides guaranteed wage employment to adult volunteers to do unskilled manual work for a minimum of 100 days?

options.text: Mahatma Gandhi National Regional Employment Guarantee Act
Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employees Grants Act
Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act
Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Grants Act

solution:
The correct answer is __**Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act.**__
